chunks: And do not make any land grant to anyone from your entourage or your relatives.

And they should not expect from you the possession of a land holding, which may cause harm to the people adjoining it regarding irrigation or shared services, whose burden they place on others. Thus, the benefit will be theirs rather than yours, and the blame will lie upon you in this world and the next.
ai.seo_question: What are the criteria for fair land grants to avoid harming neighbors according to Malik al-Ashtar's instructions?
ai.summary: This directive highlights the principle of *adl* (justice) in administrative resource allocation, warning against nepotism that creates economic burdens for the general populace. In Shia political thought, the governor is held personally accountable (*mas'uliyyah*) for systemic injustices caused by his appointees, linking administrative efficiency with spiritual accountability in both the worldly and afterlife realms.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Do not make any land grants to your hangers on or supporters.

They should not expect from you the possession of land which may cause harm to adjoining people over the question of irrigation or common services whose burden the grantees place on others. In this way, the benefit will be rather theirs than yours, and the blame will lie on you in this world and the next.
